acceptanceCriteria: A proposed spec (human acceptance required) defines fault derivation, the single-step-failure pass rule, revision binding, --all-steps semantics, UNPROVEN abstention, non-goals, failure modes and rollback, consistent with the existing test-validity contract.
After acceptance: implementation with focused and hostile tests, a real Playwright qualification and sealed change evidence; GitHub #682 closed by the merged PR.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#682. The test-validity strength axis needs a negative control (with the witnessed outcome altered, the named assertion step fails); today each control is hand-authored per variation (~3,600 controls in one adopter queue) and not reusable across revisions. Proposal: corvint test-validity negate --spec S --test T --step <title> reruns the test with a fault injected for that step's observable (Playwright network fault rewriting the response recorded in the passing run's trace, or a DOM fault hiding/altering the asserted element); PASS only when the named step and only that step fails; result stored on the strength axis bound to the revision; --all-steps covers every step in one run via expect.soft; steps with no derivable fault report strength UNPROVEN (manual control needed).
title: test-validity: generate step-level negative controls by fault injection (GitHub #682)
